title: Global bifurcation of doubly periodic gravity-capillary waves on Beltrami flows
summary: We prove the existence of a global family of steady, doubly periodic gravity-capillary waves on Beltrami flows. This is the first rigorous existence result for genuinely three-dimensional inviscid surface waves, with or without vorticity, beyond the perturbative regime close to simple explicit solutions. The proof is based on reformulating the steady water wave problem as a bifurcation problem of the form `identity plus compact' and applying a global bifurcation argument in Hölder spaces.
